author: Julian B.
title: Resoled once already
body: Bought my first pair three years ago, had them resoled last month, they look better than new. This second pair is the same quality.

author: Amelia N.
title: Runs slightly narrow
body: Gorgeous oxford, but I'd size up half a size if you have a wider foot. Check the size guide first.

author: Marcus F.
title: Lives in these
body: Softest suede I've owned, broke in within a day and haven't taken them off since.

author: Elena R.
title: Great everyday loafer
body: True to size, comfortable from the first wear. Only wish the suede protector spray came included.

author: Nina K.
title: No logo, no problem
body: Exactly the clean white sneaker I was looking for. The leather is already softening up nicely.

author: Leo M.
title: Good but keep them dry
body: Comfortable and true to size. Got caught in the rain once and had to condition them right after — worth the care spray.

author: Sofia M.
title: Stunning for evening
body: The velvet catches the light beautifully and the heel height is manageable for a whole night out.

author: Amelia N.
title: Beautiful but not for standing all night
body: Gorgeous shoe, just be realistic about the 90mm heel if you're on your feet for hours.

author: Julian B.
title: Perfect for city winters
body: Kept my feet dry through a whole wet week and the block heel is stable on cobblestones.

author: Nina K.
title: Solid boot
body: Well made and warm enough for most of the season. Runs slightly big — I'd size down half a size.

author: Marcus F.
title: Simple and well made
body: Comfortable straight out of the box, the leather footbed molds to your foot within a few wears.

author: Elena R.
title: Tougher than expected
body: Handled a full week of hiking trails and still look sharp with jeans afterward.
